records.fact: Stripe, Inc. (dual-headquartered in South San Francisco, California, United States, and Dublin, Ireland) is a privately owned financial technology company with a valuation of about $159 billion and over $1.9 trillion in payment volume processed in 2025, processing transactions for 5 million businesses in that year.
